purpose: Teach: かねて/余暇/車中/留まる/論拠/言い過ぎ/御用/競走

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、かねて、絶対、から、絶対、注視、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We at the police department have been watching this case closely and continuously. I appreciate your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured and official, but not distant. Clear diction on key words. Steady breathing, no rush. The tone of someone who has said this before and means it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、余暇、絶対、安全、絶対、当社、絶対、注意喚起、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been making sure our staff prioritize safety in all their activities outside of work. Thank you for your attention to this.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Nods slightly with the opening. Even pacing. Careful word choice — he's speaking to authority and choosing his words deliberately.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、車中、絶対、聴取、絶対、行うこと、絶対、ございます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police will conduct interviews in our vehicles as part of the investigation. It's a standard procedure.
lines.style: Professional and calm. No apology in the voice — this is routine. Slight pause before "vehicles" to let the information land. Even tempo throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様、本気で、絶対、現状に、絶対、留まる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、改革、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand. It sounds like the police department isn't staying with the status quo — you're actively working to improve things. That's good to hear.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly appreciative. Slight lift on "improve" — he's registering this as progress. Warm but respectful. Not flattering, just genuine acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、捜査の、絶対、論拠、絶対、市民の方々に、絶対、ご説明、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police will explain the basis of our investigation to the citizens involved. Transparency is important to us.
lines.style: Direct and steady. Slight emphasis on "explain" — this is a commitment, not a promise easily made. Calm authority. No hedging in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様への、本気で、絶対、言い過ぎ、絶対、ない、絶対、対応、絶対、心掛けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being careful not to overstate things when we speak with the police. We want to be respectful and accurate in everything we say.
lines.style: Measured and thoughtful. Slight hesitation before "overstate" — he's choosing his words carefully. Gentle but deliberate. The tone of someone taking responsibility.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、御用、絶対、聞き、絶対、市民の信頼、絶対、保っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police listen to what the community needs. We're working to maintain the trust that citizens place in us.
lines.style: Grounded and sincere. Slight warmth under the formality — this is about relationship, not just procedure. Even breathing. The words "listen" and "trust" land with quiet intention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域での、本気で、絶対、防犯、絶対、競走、絶対、にならない、絶対、よう、絶対、連携しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're coordinating with the local community to make sure crime prevention doesn't become a competitive issue between us. We want to work together.
lines.style: Open and collaborative. Slight emphasis on "together" — he's signaling partnership, not hierarchy. Warm but professional. The pace is unhurried, suggesting genuine commitment to dialogue.
